A24.message: A24: only *.test.ts(x) files and files under test/ import a Package's test helpers; production code imports @n8io/baseline-<package>, where its memory adapter is

A9.message: A9: contexts and the UI never log; return an error or set a span attribute, and log in the entry points (src/ui/entry.server.tsx for page errors)

A10-contexts.message: A10: contexts never import the UI; the UI calls the context

A19.message: A19: only *.test.ts files (and adapters/outbound/) import memory adapters; production code gets ports from <context>PortsCreate in adapters/outbound/index.ts

A21.message: A21: business code imports only @n8io/baseline-result and @n8io/baseline-id, plus @n8io/baseline-telemetry/span in application/ and the types Inbox (queue) and Actor (authn) in domain/ and application/; reach any other shared package through a port implemented in adapters/outbound/

A2.message: A2: domain/ is pure: it imports only its own domain/, zod, src/id-schema.ts, the result Package and the types of the authn and id Packages; move this to a Use case in application/

A21-application.message: A21: business code imports only @n8io/baseline-result and @n8io/baseline-id, plus @n8io/baseline-telemetry/span in application/ and the types Inbox (queue) and Actor (authn) in domain/ and application/; reach any other shared package through a port implemented in adapters/outbound/

A21-queue.message: A21: business code imports only the Inbox type from @n8io/baseline-queue

A21-authn.message: A21: business code imports only the Actor type from @n8io/baseline-authn

A5.message: A5: outside a context, import only src/contexts/<context>/index.ts, its one interface: build it with <context>ContextCreate, or export the Public contract you need from it

A8-opentelemetry.message: A8: src/ never imports OpenTelemetry; use telemetrySpanAttributesSet and telemetrySpanRun from @n8io/baseline-telemetry/span

A8-span.message: A8: only Use cases touch spans; set span attributes in application/, and wrap Use cases with telemetryUseCasesTrace in the context's index.ts

A22-varlock.message: A22: only src/env.ts imports varlock/env; import ENV from #env in an entry point or src/connections.ts

A22-env.message: A22: only the entry points and src/connections.ts read #env; pass the values in as arguments (the UI gets them from the load context)

A10-ui.message: A10: the UI calls contexts only through src/contexts/<context>/index.ts; loaders and actions get Use cases from the load context

A6-root.message: A6: contexts never import each other; read another through an anti-corruption layer in adapters/outbound/<context>-<upstream>-acl.ts, or handle its Event in adapters/inbound/<context>-<upstream>-<event>-handler.ts

A7.message: A7: .openapi( and @hono/* appear only in a context's adapters/inbound/; put OpenAPI schemas and routes in adapters/inbound/<model>-routes.ts

A1-root.message: A1: business code (root files, domain/, application/) never imports adapters/ or its context's index.ts, which imports every adapter; declare what it needs as a port in domain/repositories.ts or application/ports.ts and let index.ts wire the adapter

A6-layer.message: A6: contexts never import each other; read another through an anti-corruption layer in adapters/outbound/<context>-<upstream>-acl.ts, or handle its Event in adapters/inbound/<context>-<upstream>-<event>-handler.ts

A1-layer.message: A1: business code (root files, domain/, application/) never imports adapters/ or its context's index.ts, which imports every adapter; declare what it needs as a port in domain/repositories.ts or application/ports.ts and let index.ts wire the adapter

A6-adapter.message: A6: contexts never import each other; read another through an anti-corruption layer in adapters/outbound/<context>-<upstream>-acl.ts, or handle its Event in adapters/inbound/<context>-<upstream>-<event>-handler.ts

A3.message: A3: adapters/inbound/ never imports adapters/outbound/ or its context's index.ts; index.ts passes it Use cases built on the adapters

A4.message: A4: adapters/outbound/ implements ports: from its context it imports only domain/, adapters/outbound/ and application/ports.ts

A6-adapter-upstream.message: A6: contexts never import each other; read another through an anti-corruption layer in adapters/outbound/<context>-<upstream>-acl.ts, or handle its Event in adapters/inbound/<context>-<upstream>-<event>-handler.ts
